Question 5
?

Let f(x,y) be a function that is differentiable at each point on the line segment AB―, where a=⟨2,5⟩ and b=⟨3,−2⟩ are the position vectors of A and B, respectively. If f(a)=−3 and f(b)=5, then according to the mean value theorem, which of the following must be true for some point C∈AB― with position vector c?

a
−2fx(c)+5fy(c)=8
b
fx(c)−7fy(c)=8
c
−fx(c)+7fy(c)=2
d
−fx(c)+7fy(c)=−2
e
7fx(c)−fy(c)=8
